北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 36℃ 较热，多喝水，注意防晒！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like 36℃, quite hot. Drink more water and use sun protection!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，出门别忘带伞，路面湿滑注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Cixi, take your umbrella. Roads are slippery, be careful.
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降12℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 32℃ 略闷，清爽出行更舒适哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 32℃, a bit muggy. Dress lightly for comfort.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阵雨潮湿，带好雨具，路滑小心慢行！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Showers and humid in Guangzhou. Bring rain gear, roads are slippery, walk slowly!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨体感 30℃，带伞防雨，小心湿滑路面。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain, feels like 30℃. Take an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天湿度大，体感 29℃，注意防潮哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with high humidity, feels like 29℃. Pay attention to dampness.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天湿度高，体感 29℃，记得多补充水分。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with high humidity, feels like 29℃. Remember to hydrate when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云体感 35℃，防晒防暑，记得多补水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 35℃. Protect from sun and heat, hydrate frequently.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天湿度 100%，体感 30℃，记得开除湿哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with 100% humidity, feels like 30℃. Remember to dehumidify.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热体感 37℃，务必做好防晒，多补充水分！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot, feels like 37℃. Be sure to protect from sun and hydrate well!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 35℃，天气炎热，注意防暑解暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 35℃. It's hot, prevent heatstroke and cool down.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温 29℃ 舒适，愉快出行哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with a comfortable 29℃. Have a pleasant outing!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳小雨，体感 27℃ 略凉，出门记得带把伞。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Shenyang, feels a bit cool at 27℃. Remember to take an umbrella.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感 22℃，早晚添衣，谨防着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 22℃. Add layers morning/evening to avoid colds.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴天风力 5级，海边活动注意安全哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny with a Force 5 wind. Be careful when engaging in beach activities.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾能见度低，驾车出行请务必减速慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has fog, visibility is low. Please slow down and drive carefully.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云风力 4级，户外活动注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with a Force 4 wind. Pay attention to wind protection and warmth outdoors.
